scorecard_narrative.summary: Framework v2 scores 91.7% across 7 domains — a strong READY FOR ADOPTION rating. The architecture, modernization, and automation domains lead (93-95), reflecting the system's strongest achievements: compound-key identity, 100%-predictive candidate engine, and 100% elimination of manual workflow coordination. The traceability domain trails (88) solely because the Admin Portal frontend is not yet built — all backend registries and cross-linking are operational. The gap from 91.7% to 100% is dominated by: (a) DL-026 governance enforcement (C1), (b) Admin Portal UI (P1/P2 phased), and (c) delta review operational data (P3 target). None of these are engine reliability concerns — all are coverage expansion and implementation phasing.
